input_ref: jump | Pharmacy advocate: What do I say before I quote a drug price?

output.reason: U-RX-EDU-001-09 is the legal pricing estimate disclaimer. It gives the exact words to say when quoting a drug price, which directly answers the question. The other two units are related checks: caregiver authorization and not giving coverage details to unverified callers. Neither one gives the statement to make before a price quote.
